en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 16.16.
Kusala-ttika, Citta-duka The Triplet on the Wholesome and the Dyad on Consciousness.
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, a non-wholesome non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, a non-unwholesome non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, a non-indeterminate non-mental state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a wholesome mental state...

Dependent on a wholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness and neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness arise by way of root condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is associated with consciousness, states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness and neither-unwholesome-nor-associated-with-consciousness arise by way of root condition... [five].
Dependent on an unwholesome state of consciousness as a phenomenon, a non-unwholesome, non-conscious phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state of consciousness as a phenomenon, a non-wholesome, non-conscious phenomenon arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state of consciousness as a phenomenon, a non-indeterminate, non-conscious phenomenon arises by way of root condition. An unwholesome state of consciousness...
Dependent on a non-wholesome and non-conscious state, and dependent on a non-indeterminate and non-conscious state, states arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome conscious state, non-wholesome and non-conscious states and non-unwholesome and non-conscious states arise by way of root-condition… (five).
Dependent on a neutral (abyākata) mental state, a non-wholesome and non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a neutral mental state, a non-unwholesome and non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a neutral mental state, both non-wholesome and non-mental states, as well as non-unwholesome and non-mental states, arise.
By way of root condition ... three. (Abbreviated.
Under root there are thirteen; under object, nine ... pe ... under result, three ... pe ... under non-disappearance, thirteen.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor dissociated from consciousness by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, a neutral state that is not associated with consciousness arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, both unwholesome states that are not associated with consciousness and neutral states that are not associated with consciousness arise by way of root condition. ... [Three.]
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, a wholesome state that is not associated with consciousness arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, an indeterminate state that is not associated with consciousness arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is not associated with consciousness, states that are both wholesome and indeterminate, neither of which are associated with consciousness, arise [by way of root condition].
They arise by way of the root condition ...
three. Three are indeterminate. (Abbreviated.
Under the root [condition] there are nine ... pe ... under the resultant [condition] there are three ... pe ... under the non-disappearance [condition] there are nine.
